name: HTS_SCHEDULE_SHIFTS
description: Table holding the shifts scheduled for employees.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_SHIFT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. System generated unique identifier for a Schedule Shift.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Schedule to which the shift belongs.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Schedule Unit to which the shift belongs.

columns.name: APPROVAL_REQ_TO_CLAIM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if an approval is needed when the shift is claimed

columns.name: SKILL_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Skill for which the shift is created.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: PersonId to which shift is assigned to.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: AssignmentId of the person to which shift is assigned to.

columns.name: SHIFT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether the shift is Regular or On-Call or any custom shift type

columns.name: SHIFT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Id of the shift type (defined as an extend lookup for the lookup type ORA_HTS_SHIFT_TYPE)

columns.name: SHIFT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the shift from Shift library associated to the Schedule Shift.

columns.name: START_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Start date time of the shift

columns.name: END_DATE_TIME
columns.description: End date time of the shift.

columns.name: START_TIME_TZ_OFFSET
columns.description: Timezone offset of shift's start time. Unit of time is minute

columns.name: END_TIME_TZ_OFFSET
columns.description: Timezone offset of shift's end time. Unit of time is minute

columns.name: REF_DATE
columns.description: Reference or Actual date of the shift.

columns.name: WORK_DURATION
columns.description: Duration of the Work in minutes

columns.name: BREAK_DURATION
columns.description: Break time in minutes

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Origin of the shift, indicating if it was imported, edited in the UI or computed.

columns.name: LOCKED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if the shift is locked for further updates.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_MODE
columns.description: Indicating how the resource was assigned to the shift or null for open shift

columns.name: SHIFT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Indicating shift's category

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: ENTERPRISE_ID

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comment that may be provided as information at creation or when updating the shift.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_BY
columns.description: Person ID of the user who assigned the scheduled shift to a worker

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time the shift was assigned to a person.

columns.name: PREMIUM_SHIFT_CODE
columns.description: A code added to the shift that qualifies the type of scheduled hours as premium

columns.name: OPPORTUNITY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the opportunity available to the worker.

columns.name: AVAIL_TO_OTHER_DEPT_FLAG
columns.description: For a opportunity shift, indicates if it is available to assignments from the departments not in the current schedule.

columns.name: SHIFT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: The field contains the unique id to group for any open shifts.Identical shifts will have the same unique id value.

columns.name: SHIFT_INCENTIVE
columns.description: Incentive provided if shift is assigned.

columns.name: ALLOW_OVERTIME_FLAG
columns.description: Flag denoting whether worker can exceed FTE with this shift.

columns.name: PAID_BREAK_DURATION
columns.description: Current paid break duration in minutes

columns.name: MANUAL_PAID_BREAK_DURATION
columns.description: Paid break duration in minutes from manual input

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Stores the external, original application reference identifier

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SOURCE
columns.description: Stores the creation source, such as Workforce Scheduling app or HCM Data Loader, until the shift is deleted

columns.name: IMPORT_PROVIDER
columns.description: Contains the Request Source value (exporter code or requestor's name) of the schedule event request that caused the shift to be created.

columns.name: ALLOW_CLAIM_PARTIAL_SHIFT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the shift can be partially claimed

columns.name: OPPORTUNITY_ROTATION_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if the oportunity shift is available for rotation
